heard: An icy moon near Uranus once erupted liquid water. Astronomer William LaSalle discovered Ariel in 1851. Ariel has the youngest, most reflective surface of Uranus' major moons. NASA's Voyager 2 flew past up close in 1986. Photos revealed deep fault valleys slicing across smooth planes. Those smooth planes formed when molten ice erupted across its crust.
